versions.subject: Windows redcannary
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith: \WMIC.exe
    CommandLine|contains: 
        - process 
        - qfe
filter:
    CommandLine|contains|all: #rule id 526be59f-a573-4eea-b5f7-f0973207634d for `wmic process call create #{process_to_execute}` 
        - call
        - create 
condition: selection and not filter

versions.subject: Updated Rules to Use OriginalFileName
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: \WMIC.exe
    - OriginalFileName|contains: 'wmic.exe'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - process
        - qfe
filter:
    CommandLine|contains|all: #rule id 526be59f-a573-4eea-b5f7-f0973207634d for `wmic process call create #{process_to_execute}` 
        - call
        - create
condition: all of selection* and not filter
versions.spl: Image="*\\WMIC.exe" OR OriginalFileName="*wmic.exe*" CommandLine IN ("*process*", "*qfe*") NOT (CommandLine="*call*" CommandLine="*create*")
